notes.title: Warp Drive!
notes.content: New core slot added, with the warp drive preinstalled! additionally some map changes, lots of bugfixes, visual particle overhauls

notes.title: Outpost map rebuild!
notes.content: and all those features I talked about in the last patch should actually work for clients now!

notes.title: New in game text chat!
notes.content: Loads of polish too, players will join on a different team automatically now, chassis mods show an error when attempting to buy without any available, and lots more!
